inputs.target_skill_path: Required root of the skill being enhanced path. It must point at the skill directory that directly contains SKILL.md and assets/so-workflow/.
inputs.goal: Required deterministic skill creation or upgrade goal.
inputs.requested_target_skill_changes: Required description of skill being enhanced files/contracts/assets to create or modify. This is the primary business-outcome contract.
inputs.target_skill_contract_path: Required target-root-relative path to the skill being enhanced's business contract. The fixed path is assets/so-workflow/contract.json; it must be read and parsed as current_contract evidence. A SHA-256 may be recorded as optional audit/version metadata, but a manual contract edit or changed hash does not by itself block execution. The enhancement skill's own contract must never substitute for the target contract.
inputs.expression_binding: Machine-readable root expression contract for workflow generation: language, languageVersion, contractId, contractVersion, requiredExpressionCapabilities, compileFeedbackContract, and allowed expression forms. Current supported language is csharp only.
inputs.gate_failure_guidance_contract: Hard workflow-generation contract: every validation gate must include failureGuidance with a concrete nextAction and evidenceReferences. Each evidence reference must use a target-relative path, verified 1-based startLine/endLine, and an exact source quote that tells the next agent how to repair the failed gate. The workflow designer must self-review every gate before returning success.
inputs.channel: Derived package channel for the enhancement pass. Infer released versus beta from the checked-in SO package lock and the bound skill package version when needed; do not ask the user to choose a channel during normal SO enhancement runs.
inputs.context_file: Optional path to a JSON context file.
inputs.workspace_root: Optional existing workspace directory outside the root of the skill being enhanced. When supplied, verified Mermaid and HTML artifacts are mirrored below the workspace for clickable links.
inputs.reference_pack_manifest: Required bounded manifest for workflow design. It uses schemaVersion workflow-designer.reference-manifest.v1; each entry requires path, runtimeVersion, authorityRole, readStatus, and validationResult. SHA-256 is optional development-support metadata, not a freshness or re-attestation gate. The selected-runtime guide/schema/demo/demo-audit entries share a generationSetId for grouping only.
inputs.schema_demo_input: Required schemaDemoInput descriptor for the selected compatible SO apphost. It contains runtime=so, runtimeBinding=dotnet-so, runtimeVersion, schemaFile, demoFile, demoCompileAudit, and generationSetId. schemaSha256 and demoSha256 are optional support metadata. The demo must compile successfully with the same apphost; source/candidate results are development-only, while package integrity remains mandatory whenever package-channel mode is used.
inputs.previous_runnable_reference: Optional previous workflow reference, readable only as previous_runnable_reference evidence. If supplied, its disposition includes source_version, source_path, copy_time, reusable_shapes, schema/requirements differences, and rejected/deprecated items; source_hash is optional support metadata and never a freshness gate.
inputs.workflow_design_output_root: Runtime-owned output root for workflow-design/reference-manifest.json, static-contract-review.json, and semantic-probe-report.json. It must remain outside the static skill bundle.

default_assumptions.published_runtime_mcp_policy: SO starts from its exact self-contained product+RID package and runs --guide directly before downstream work. MCP is optional for later steps; it is never a package-startup, guide, or pre-guide inspection gate. A dispatched MCP operation failure remains a failure.
default_assumptions.package_index_source: Acquire the exact locked product+RID package from NuGet.org using registration SHA-512 metadata. The same-version GitHub Release asset is a fallback only when its matching .sha512 sidecar verifies.
default_assumptions.target_product_rule: Any Loom Skill Orchestrator skill or target product that adopts Loom-bin-based skills must preserve released and beta package index absolute URLs in its own skill or product-facing docs, using localized mirrors when the product exposes localized package index pages.
default_assumptions.runtime_install_root: Detect one supported host RID from OS, architecture, and Linux libc. Acquire, validate, and extract only the exact product+RID self-contained runtime package; fail closed when detection or validation is ambiguous.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_restore: Prefer a fully validated immutable generation in the shared current-user OS-temp AO/SO cache, keyed by exact package ID/version/RID/full verified .nupkg SHA-512. On a miss, check the standard NuGet global-packages cache, then acquire the exact locked package and safely extract it outside the skill bundle.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_cache_policy: Share immutable product+RID generations across AO and SO in the current-user OS-temp cache. Recompute the full .nupkg SHA-512 and verify package identity before reuse; stage and validate repairs before atomic publication; never overwrite a different valid or in-use generation. Do not add a cache lock or float to latest.
default_assumptions.published_package_workflow_rule: For /loom-skill-enhancement itself and any Loom-governanced skill being enhanced, official workflow operations must use the published SO package artifacts for the skill-bound version and derived channel as the normal execution surface. Do not use repository-source builds, ad hoc local project outputs, or hand-assembled runtime folders as the standard workflow-operation path unless a blocked-state emergency exception was explicitly approved.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_layout: One exact-version self-contained package for the current product and detected RID contains the apphost and English docs. Extract it to an external per-run directory and invoke the apphost directly.
default_assumptions.fresh_runtime_copy_rule: Every new official SO run must start from a freshly copied external runtime workflow file derived from checked-in source workflow assets. Resume in that same execution chain must continue against that same persisted runtime copy. Do not execute by mutating the checked-in template in place.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_fallback: The only package fallback is the same-version GitHub Release asset when its .sha512 sidecar validates. Do not switch to a DLL, framework-dependent bundle, source build, or another RID.
default_assumptions.runtime_startup_contract: Before extraction, verify the exact package ID/version/RID, registration or sidecar SHA-512, nuspec, fixed runtime.json manifest, archive limits and paths, apphost, and English guide assets. Reject path traversal, duplicate entries, and oversized files.
default_assumptions.runtime_preflight_gate: Fail closed unless the exact package and archive validate, extraction succeeds, and the apphost and guide files exist at the manifest paths. Immediately run the extracted apphost --guide and validate its exact version and readable contained paths before any other runtime command.
default_assumptions.package_channel_launch_mode: There is one launch mode: direct execution of the exact self-contained apphost for the detected RID (so.exe on Windows, so on Unix).
default_assumptions.powershell_5_1_http_probe_rule: When Windows PowerShell 5.1 uses Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod for package-channel HTTP probes, add -UseBasicParsing so runtime acquisition does not stall on legacy browser-engine security prompts.
default_assumptions.business_scope_rule: Loom Skill Orchestrator enhancement business is always to create or modify deliverables of the skill being enhanced. Runtime validation is supporting work and cannot replace skill being enhanced delivery outputs.
default_assumptions.runtime_version_semantic_drift_rule: Treat every bound SO version change as schema-contract plus execution-semantics drift. Before target edits or batch execution, run inherited-pattern and replacement variants of a minimal three-node fixture on the exact selected runtime, inspect terminal context/final output/events/audit evidence, and require the replacement to reach final Done with non-empty expected values. Compile success alone is insufficient.
default_assumptions.known_03282_context_write_rule: The released 0.3.282 probe showed that literal updates on plain ToolCall/noop do not create context values. StateUpdate and MemoryWrite apply declared updates. Real tool and proven external resume $result projections remain emitter-specific; never use a declaration or self-binding as producer evidence.
default_assumptions.batch_migration_playbook_rule: When multiple declared skills being enhanced share an obsolete workflow pattern, prepare idempotent migration scripts for noop-to-stateUpdate conversion, output-family binding completion, and unsupported $result cleanup before the first target run. Preserve dry-scan manifests, changed/unchanged/failed target lists, and post-migration validation; script and intermediate source/candidate hashes are optional development-support metadata, never substitutes for actual target-output checks.
default_assumptions.durable_decision_evidence_rule: Persist assumptions, probe fixtures, command/result summaries, migration manifests, decisions, superseded decisions, events.jsonl, and audit references under <execution-output-root>/evidence/. Conversation text is not execution evidence.
default_assumptions.workflow_identity_rule: For root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, every workflow must declare taskType, workflowKind, caseId, and runId. Valid pairs are skill_enhancement with so_self_bootstrap or target_skill_enhancement, and a target-specific taskType with target_skill_business. Checked-in template runIds may use the template: prefix; fresh materialization replaces that marker with one generated run-<guid> while resume preserves the same runId.
default_assumptions.guide_hub_structure: The authoritative SO guide source is docs/en/guides/so-guide.md; the extracted runtime uses guides/so-guide.md as its guide_path entry, with adjacent flow, concise reference index, and chapter pages in the same docs bundle.
default_assumptions.target_skill_guide_hub_structure: When an skill being enhanced publishes a guide hub, keep its fixed guide entry at or below 200 lines and split operational flow and detailed reference into adjacent flow and reference pages without changing the guide_path contract.
default_assumptions.guide_freshness_rule: Every enhancement pass must verify and safely extract the exact locked self-contained SO RID package, then directly run its apphost --guide as the first runtime operation. Parse the JSON result and verify exact version, absolute contained docs_root and guide_path, and readability before downstream work. No resolver, descriptor, or pre-guide MCP/fragment gate is required.
default_assumptions.runtime_execution_authority_rule: The exact published self-contained SO apphost controls guide, compile, run, and resume for the same external workflow copy. MCP may support a later step but does not replace direct apphost execution or block startup.
default_assumptions.boundary_check_approval_gate: Every governed transition still requires a machine-readable boundary check on the same external workflow copy. Owner-crossing seams require explicit approval or structured continuation. Package and guide validation are direct-apphost evidence; bounded MCP or CLI fragment inspection is not a bootstrap prerequisite.
default_assumptions.boundary_check_fail_closed: Missing predicates, ownership violations, route gaps, invalid package/hash/manifest/archive/extraction evidence, an unreadable guide, or missing explicit continuation fail closed. Do not fabricate success, switch workflow copies, claim completion from a blocked payload, or substitute a repository build.
default_assumptions.official_execution_completion_gate: Official business execution and governed delivery that require skill outputs use the public self-contained so[.exe] run/resume chain on one external workflow copy through final Done. A development-only phase-design iteration may stop after complete owning-product compile, all required semantic probes, and production validation of any target business outputs it exercised. Compile alone never proves business completion.

invariants: workflow_file is external and not the checked-in source template
blocked status requires resume or terminal failure evidence

default_assumptions.checked_in_asset_boundary_rule: When MemoryRead inspects checked-in assets of the skill being enhanced, require an explicit asset root via assetRootInput or assetRootPath, load real file snapshots from disk, and reject absolute paths or traversal that escapes that declared root.
default_assumptions.meta_run_prohibition: Loom Skill Orchestrator enhancement has no standalone meta-run completion path. Do not report completion from runtime-only validation when requested changes to the skill being enhanced are missing.
default_assumptions.minimal_target_dependency_policy: When the target project does not already have its own dependencies installed, install only the minimum dependency set required to complete the requested changes to the skill being enhanced and current guide-aligned validation work. Do not widen into unrelated package restore or optional toolchain installation.
default_assumptions.think_out_loud_contract: After every SO binary execution (so.exe on Windows or so on Unix), begin the user-facing report with exactly four verified Markdown link-plus-fence pairs in this exact order: Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow. Each title must link to a complete local file URL the active host has verified it can open: Windows uses file://C:/..., Linux/macOS use file:///.... Encode every space as %20 in the URL and repeat that identical encoded URL in the following text fence; do not include literal spaces in the URL. If a file URL cannot be opened, create and verify a mirror and use its encoded file URL. Never omit the scheme, truncate the URL, substitute a code-fenced path for a link, or reuse an unverified stale address. If no URL opens, follow delivery_failed handling and emit no artifact links. Follow the pairs with localized execution-confidence and estimated-overall-progress headings in that order, each with a short reason. If an artifact is missing or unverified, follow delivery-failure/continuity rules and never invent its address. Confidence estimates likelihood of successful completion; overall progress estimates completion of the whole request. Use verified evidence only; neither percentage replaces actual completion evidence.
default_assumptions.plain_language_feedback_contract: All user-facing progress, blocked, error, and completion updates from SO, AO-facing handoffs, and every skill being enhanced must use the user's requested language and plain everyday wording. Keep exact commands, paths, IDs, and evidence fields in separate technical details only when needed. Every skill being enhanced must report execution confidence and estimated overall progress after each execution update. Whenever a skill being enhanced runs or reports an AO/SO workflow execution, require the fixed Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow report in that order. Each title must link to a complete local file URL the active host has verified it can open: Windows uses file://C:/..., Linux/macOS use file:///.... Encode every space as %20 and repeat the identical encoded URL in the following text fence. If a file URL cannot be opened, create and verify a mirror and use its encoded file URL. Never include literal spaces in the URL, omit the scheme, truncate the URL, substitute a code-fenced path for a clickable link, or reuse an unverified stale address. If no URL opens, follow delivery-failure guidance without artifact links. Require the target SKILL.md, user-facing subagent prompts, failure guidance, and workflow hints to preserve this exact format and address rule.
default_assumptions.progress_report_log_contract: After each post-execution progress report from /loom-skill-enhancement or a skill it creates or updates, write the complete Markdown entry to a separate external file with ISO 8601 UTC and local timestamps including numeric UTC offset and OS timezone ID. From the repository root, invoke the platform helper with absolute paths: Windows uses `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/AppendProgressReport.ps1 -TargetFile <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md -EntryFile <entry-file>`; Linux/macOS use `bash scripts/AppendProgressReport.sh --target-file <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md --entry-file <entry-file>`. The helper reads only the entry file, appends to the target, and returns the target's full file URL; use that exact URL if reporting the log location. Never read, open, or inspect the existing progress-report.md, and never use manual append or read-modify-write. If it fails, report the failure and pause later business-step progression without changing runtime execution state.
default_assumptions.file_input_preparation_contract: All file input parameters are path-only. The caller must create, finish, and close every required input file before one CLI call; the CLI preflights the complete set before reading, executing, modifying, or writing. Inline script, JSON, patch, and replacement content is rejected. Output paths are destinations owned by the CLI.
default_assumptions.workflow_file_language: Use the exact selected runtime's fresh English guide, same-apphost schema/demo and successful compile, and version-matched English docs as technical authority for runtime, CLI, schema, and workflow-control semantics. Translated public docs are localization checks only and cannot override that authority. Workflow definition files are the canonical English information carrier for workflow-owned schema keys, node and transition names/descriptions, phases, expressions, hints, failure guidance, evidence references, and control metadata across AO, SO, and skills being enhanced. Keep user/business payload values and localized presentation in their source/requested language and do not change control semantics.
default_assumptions.must_show_to_user_files_rule: After every direct SO apphost call, populate must_show_to_user_files with the actual audit paths and verify they exist and are readable. This is an audit list, not a link guarantee. The fixed report contains four Markdown link-plus-fence pairs in Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow order; each link targets a complete local file URL that the active host has verified it can open, and its text fence repeats that same URL. Use file://C:/... on Windows and file:///... on Linux/macOS. Encode every space as %20 and repeat that identical encoded URL in the link and text fence; do not include literal spaces. If a file URL cannot be opened, create and verify a mirror and use its encoded file URL. Never omit the scheme, truncate the URL, or reuse an unverified stale address. For not_emitted, reuse a prior artifact set only after re-verifying that every URL still opens; otherwise report missing evidence without links. runtime_path_only is technical evidence only when the active host cannot open it. For delivery_failed or no open URL, emit no artifact links or notifications and report the next action.
default_assumptions.executor: The AI agent directly runs the extracted product apphost for guide, compile, run, resume, status, and inspection operations. No resolver or apphost identity selects a DLL or executable.
default_assumptions.plan_artifact_ownership: Temporary runtime-owned artifact for one enhancement run. Write it only under <execution-output-root>/plan/skill-plan.md. Never copy, move, migrate, or include its content in the skill being enhanced assets, package, release, or deliverables. Runtime-owned context and completion evidence may retain its path; a hash is optional development-support metadata and never a freshness gate.
default_assumptions.workflow_designer_agent: Use .agents/skills/loom-skill-enhancement/assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-designer.agent.md as the required local subagent for workflow generation or workflow revision, and pass relative-link context for guide files, package-index files, SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced, package lock, workflow JSON, and audit artifacts.
default_assumptions.workflow_description_granularity: Fine-grained, derived from the current SKILL.md decision tree when it exists, or from goal plus supporting references when creating a greenfield skill, and then reviewed by the maintainer.
default_assumptions.plan_mode_before_editing: Before deliverables of the skill being enhanced are modified, analyze skill being enhanced inputs, outputs, state nodes, transition groups, guards, branches, loops, user seams, runtime seams, validation gates, and output evidence, then generate a workflow template and user-readable review plan.
default_assumptions.workflow_template_is_authority: User feedback during plan review must be reflected in the workflow template or its source planning inputs. Mermaid, HTML, and localized plan prose are presentation layers and cannot be the only changed artifacts.
default_assumptions.workflow_json_edit_policy: Normal workflow governance uses the direct SO apphost guide, compile, run, and resume operations. Do not treat checked-in workflow JSON as a routine direct-edit surface.
default_assumptions.workflow_json_blocked_override_only: Direct workflow JSON edits are allowed only when the current SO path is fully blocked, the user explicitly approves a minimal workaround, and the operator immediately returns to direct so.exe/so compile, run, or resume.
default_assumptions.running_workflow_copy_edit_rule: Manual edits to the running external workflow .json copy are last-resort blocked-state emergency workarounds only. They must not be treated as a normal workflow-operation path for /loom-skill-enhancement or any Loom-governanced skill being enhanced.
default_assumptions.compiled_analysis_artifact: Each SO compile/run/resume audit step writes workflow.analysis.json and workflow.dataflow.json next to workflow.mermaid.md, workflow.html, and workflow.json. The analysis report summarizes inputs, output families, branches, loops, seams, gates, and Turing-complete control risk.
default_assumptions.json_file_output_format: Every valid workflow, template, schema, demo, runtime-copy, audit-backup, analysis, dataflow, and compile-feedback JSON file written to disk must be pretty-printed over multiple lines with indentation; compact JSON is reserved for JSONL, MCP/CLI wire payloads, and explicit canonical hash projections.
default_assumptions.output_path_addressability: Output targets may be outside the Git worktree or ignored by Git. Return normalized real filesystem paths, verify existence and readability before reporting them, and when a workspace root is available provide a verified workspace-relative mirror that the editor can open directly; Git tracking is never a delivery condition.
default_assumptions.node_type_visualization: Mermaid visualization derives light node background colors from workflow step kind semantics plus owned-input metadata: AI/model/subagent green, code/tool blue, user-owned optional branch choice yellow, required user input red, generic conditional branches amber/yellow, and gate/governance states white or very light gray.
default_assumptions.node_to_file_map: Skills being enhanced must include a node-to-file or node-to-artifact map that connects workflow nodes to target-internal files, generated artifacts, or evidence records they govern. Any checked-in document path in the map must be relative to the root of the skill being enhanced.
default_assumptions.node_to_file_map_path_policy: Every checked-in document path named by node-to-file-map.md must use target-skill-root-relative POSIX separators, must resolve inside <target-skill-root>, and must not be absolute, use .. traversal, or point at repository-global docs/ or another skill root. Runtime-owned per-run outputs may use explicit <execution-output-root> placeholders, but they must not be presented as checked-in document ownership.
default_assumptions.target_internal_document_copy_policy: If a node map or contract for the skill being enhanced needs SO or AO reference material that is not already inside the skill being enhanced, copy the smallest required English reference or contract excerpt into <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/reference/so/ or <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/reference/ao/. Never copy the complete so-guide*.md or ao-guide*.md pages into a skill being enhanced. These local copies are context/reference material only; the fresh published-runtime guide_path remains the version-specific authority.
default_assumptions.target_specific_contract_policy: Every enhancement and re-enhancement must require one target-owned machine-readable contract at <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/contract.json. It must be read from the declared target asset root and parsed as JSON before planning or workflow authoring. At minimum it must contain a non-empty name, inputs object, outputs object, and default_assumptions object. A SHA-256 may be recorded as optional audit/version metadata; manual edits are allowed and a changed hash must refresh metadata or cache state rather than block by itself. The contract describes the skill being enhanced's business intent and constraints; the enhancement skill's own contract is governance authority and must never be copied or used as the target contract.
default_assumptions.target_specific_contract_gate: The target-specific contract gate fails closed when assets/so-workflow/contract.json is missing, unreadable, malformed, outside the declared target root, or missing required surfaces. When a referencePackManifest is produced, it should record the contract as current_contract evidence, but a missing or changed optional SHA-256 does not by itself block planning or execution; the current file is authoritative after a successful read.
default_assumptions.target_internal_document_copy_manifest: Every target-internal SO/AO document copy must be listed in <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/reference/document-copy-manifest.json with schema_version, target_path, source_path, source_product, source_channel, source_version, artifact_origin, authority_scope, and refreshed_by. source_sha256 may be recorded as optional development-support metadata; it is not a freshness gate. Keep package source version and copied content provenance accurate.
default_assumptions.weave_out_subagent_review_rule: Before completion, review every current weave-out and decide whether it should be implemented as a dedicated local subagent for the skill being enhanced under assets/{skillname}-{taskname}.agent.md. When the answer is yes, create or refresh that subagent file and add relative-link references in the SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced and reference docs for the skill being enhanced before the workflow can complete.
default_assumptions.review_fix_loop_rule: Before completion, run an explicit review-skill to fix-skill loop on the skill being enhanced, then produce commit-and-report-ready evidence rather than stopping at first-pass authoring or template compile.
default_assumptions.completion_verdict_reuse_rule: Governance verdict and evidence checklist requirements must reuse the existing runtime-owned evidence families and completion-manifest surfaces instead of introducing a parallel completion schema. The terminal completion manifest may summarize the final completion verdict, current status and node, whether final Done was reached, any missing evidence, the next action, and explicit mappings back to workflow_runtime_copy_json, event_log_file, review_fix_loop_evidence, commit_report_ready, and the checked-in deliverable references, but it must not self-certify missing pre-existing runtime evidence by inventing a new route-proof surface inside the terminal step itself.
default_assumptions.confirmation_loop: Before execution, present the analysis report, compiled Mermaid, localized review plan, route gates, branch/loop summary, and node-to-file map to the user. Repeat by updating the workflow template and recompiling until the user confirms the workflow reflects the intended design.
default_assumptions.shared_context_batch_methodology: After selecting and validating one compatible runtime and capturing its fresh guide, build one bounded shared review context from current snapshots and runtime inputs. Preserve source_manifest, guide/schema/runtime references, and external workflow-copy identity; context_hash is optional support metadata and never an attestation or freshness gate. Independent reviews run in complete batches, then aggregate, repair, revalidate, and finish with serial checks.
default_assumptions.context_merge: When references Markdown sources exist, concatenate references/*.md into a temporary merged-context.md working note with clear section headers, then convert the needed content into a temporary JSON context file for SO run context input.
default_assumptions.template_and_audit_layout: Store the workflow template JSON separately. Unless the user explicitly chooses an audit destination, keep event_log, Mermaid, HTML, and workflow backups under a user-level temporary audit root instead of the skill being enhanced directory.
default_assumptions.template_node_governance: Workflow templates must model explicit governed steps, guards, seams, and reviewable outputs. Never author or keep any node whose purpose says or implies run a multistep plan. Review templates for any node whose instruction embeds a multistep plan or a broad prompt to an agent, then split that work into explicit deterministic steps instead of hiding it behind a generic planner node.
default_assumptions.workflow_designer_granularity_rule: Workflow-designer subagents for AO and SO must generate node-level granularity where each node owns one visible responsibility, no node hides a visible subflow, and every weave-out branch has a detailed blocked-action hint that cites local relative-link context when available.
default_assumptions.target_skill_agent_link_rule: If SO enhancement introduces a local `{target-skill-name}-{task-name}.agent.md`, the SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced must reference that file with a relative link and the workflow template JSON weave-out hints or equivalent skill_hint guidance must reference the same file by relative path.
default_assumptions.target_skill_agent_dispatch_rule: Every subagent invocation in the skill being enhanced must state the exact agent name declared in the referenced .agent.md frontmatter and include a clickable Markdown link to that same file; a name, path, or summary alone is insufficient. The target SKILL.md must explain that dedicated-agent registration is optional dispatch convenience, not a capability gate. When exact-name resolution fails, resolve the file from the current skill/workspace copy first and the matching global installed-skill copy second, then pass its full contents and all required inputs/reference context to a capable registered generic subagent as driver. Require the driver to perform the declared role and return its output contract. Registration absence alone never blocks work or requires user approval; stop only if the file is missing/ambiguous or no capable driver exists.
default_assumptions.governed_template_validation_contract: For templates for the skill being enhanced that use root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, add a root validation contract with gates, routes, declaredUserOwnedFields, and reservedRuntimeOwnedFields.
default_assumptions.business_output_gate_rule: Terminal governed routes must satisfy target-declared business-output gates before done. Compute and verify every hash required by the target business contract against the actual artifact using its declared algorithm and canonicalization. Missing, invalid, or mismatched required hashes block acceptance and delivery even during development; do not add mandatory hashes to unrelated support files. Blocked routes must satisfy declared strongest-earned blocked-output gates before a runtime-owned wait boundary.
default_assumptions.seam_ownership_rule: AskUser seams may request only declared user-owned fields or decisions. Runtime-owned facts, provenance, workflow paths, event-log paths, and audit artifact paths belong to runtime-owned seams such as WaitResume.
default_assumptions.locked_runtime_version: Write a machine-readable lock for the exact SO package version, channel, package identity, and supported RID. At runtime, prefer a validated shared current-user OS-temp generation, then the standard NuGet cache; verify exact package ID/version/RID and full .nupkg SHA-512 and acquire only that locked package on a miss. Never float to latest.
default_assumptions.target_skill_lock_reference: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced must reference assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json as the exact SO package-version authority, require validation of the exact product+RID package, and forbid floating to latest.
default_assumptions.target_skill_json_edit_policy: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced must state that ordinary workflow changes use the direct SO apphost guide/compile/run/resume operations and that direct workflow JSON edits are blocked-state-only, user-approved emergency workarounds.
default_assumptions.target_skill_selective_json_reading_poli: Every target SKILL.md includes the selective JSON guidance: for JSON larger than 16 KiB (16,384 UTF-8 bytes), default to selective reads; use search or regex only to locate, then bounded line windows; use JSON Pointer or a structured parser for minified/unsafe slices; read the full JSON only on explicit user request or whole-document validation; preserve the .agent.md full-read exception.
default_assumptions.target_skill_runtime_restore_policy: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced must state that .nupkg files are ZIP content, must be extracted with ZIP-aware APIs, and that failed package validation, extraction, apphost startup, or guide checks cannot be recorded as success.
default_assumptions.target_skill_published_package_rule: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced must explicitly state that official workflow operations use the published SO package artifacts for the bound version and derived channel as the normal execution surface, and that repository-source builds or hand-assembled runtimes are not the default path.
default_assumptions.target_skill_runtime_copy_policy: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced must explicitly state that every new official SO run starts from a freshly copied external runtime workflow file rather than the checked-in template itself, while resume continues against the same persisted runtime copy from that execution chain.
default_assumptions.target_skill_progress_report_policy: Every skill being enhanced must state in its SKILL.md that each complete post-execution progress report is first written to a separate external entry file, then appended by the platform helper from the repository root: Windows uses `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/AppendProgressReport.ps1 -TargetFile <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md -EntryFile <entry-file>`; Linux/macOS uses `bash scripts/AppendProgressReport.sh --target-file <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md --entry-file <entry-file>`. Include ISO 8601 UTC and local timestamps with numeric UTC offset and OS timezone ID. The helper reads only the entry file, append-writes the target, and returns its full file URL; use that URL verbatim if reporting the log address. Never read, open, inspect, or copy the existing progress-report.md, and never use manual append or read-modify-write. On failure, report it and pause later business progression without changing runtime execution state.
default_assumptions.target_skill_workflow_file_language: The skill being enhanced must state that its workflow definition files are canonical English information carriers for workflow-owned schema and control metadata; user/business payload values and localized user-facing output remain source/request-language data.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_upgrade_policy: When re-enhancing a governed skill, use its exact locked published SO version, reacquire and validate the matching self-contained RID package, directly run --guide, and read the returned guide_path before editing.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_subagent_review: For targets already enhanced by Loom Skill Orchestrator, strongly recommend a subagent review that compares the existing skill and workflow assets against the guide result captured from the current skill-bound runtime before editing.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_template_strategy_policy: After the three re-enhancement gap reviews, explicitly classify the change as local_patch, structural_refactor, or full_regeneration. For structural_refactor or full_regeneration, use the old checked-in template as a baseline input together with current requirements, concept documents, assets of the skill being enhanced, and the fresh guide to generate a new candidate template. Apply the same policy to /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap without recursively starting another enhancement run.
default_assumptions.template_validation_gate: Official template acceptance/adoption requires the exact published self-contained SO package identity, SHA-512, manifest, archive, extraction, and fresh direct-apphost guide checks; that same apphost controls official compile/run/resume through final Done. A development-only phase iteration may use a compatible current-source/candidate SO apphost for the host RID and must obtain guide, schema/demo, demo compile, and phase/full compile from that same selected apphost; label evidence development-only. It cannot satisfy official package or business-output gates.
default_assumptions.template_validation_scope: For templates for the skill being enhanced that use root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, compile success also requires the root validation contract, route-aware business-output gates, strongest-earned blocked-output declarations, and seam ownership declarations to pass compile and workflow-load validation.
default_assumptions.template_authority: The reviewed workflow template becomes execution authority after alignment with the exact package guide, governance review, and direct apphost compile. The same apphost controls run/resume on the external workflow copy until final Done.
default_assumptions.skill_markdown_shape: Compress the enhanced SKILL.md to about 80-100 lines while preserving high-level steps, guardrail headings, Loom Skill Orchestrator guidance, and the ## Workflow Contract title.
default_assumptions.released_channel_wording: If released artifacts do not provide the same Loom Skill Orchestrator enhancement surface, label that capability Beta Only.
default_assumptions.weave_out_policy: Use structured blocked payload fields such as current_step_kind to classify WaitResume handling, and consume skill_hint literally as the next external action instruction. Ask the user only when the structured payload indicates mandatory human-input seams. For waits on email, files, messages, or downstream script results, treat the state as a valid external wait that either returns the expected next input shape to the user or pauses until the external result arrives. Continue automatically only when the structured payload plus literal skill_hint point to a non-human continuation.
default_assumptions.skill_layer_scope: These defaults are skill-layer adaptation defaults rather than generic SO runtime guarantees. If the guide captured from the bound runtime version does not expose an equivalent surface, mark that behavior as Beta Only.
default_assumptions.shared_review_context: Bounded shared review context built after selecting a compatible runtime and capturing a fresh guide. Include the source manifest, bounded snapshots, selected guide/schema/runtime references, and the same external workflow-copy identity. context_hash is optional development-support metadata, not a freshness or re-attestation gate.
default_assumptions.emitter_aware_producer_rule: Governed dataflow must distinguish declarations from concrete producers. Known-null emitters, unknown tools, missing required tool parameters, and same-transition self-bindings fail closed; legitimate real-tool, literal-writer, and external-result emitters require their exact projection and runtime evidence.
default_assumptions.gov4_reachability_probe: Before accepting a governed producer reference through a branch or cycle, run the 0.3.282 gov4 fixture. A producer strictly before a consumer is available; an active back edge is not a first-pass producer; and a producer on only one branch cannot satisfy a post-join consumer.
default_assumptions.runtime_semantic_migration_reference: Read reference/runtime-semantic-migration.md for the 0.3.282 semantic matrix, producer legitimacy, gov4 probe, migration manifest, resume payload, and Windows tooling rules.
default_assumptions.review_commit_scope_rule: When the review-and-commit phase starts, review, fix, validate, and commit every non-ignored dirty tracked or untracked file in the worktree, not only the current implementation slice. A clean unrelated file may be included unchanged; an unrelated risk pauses the handoff for confirmation.
default_assumptions.apphost_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping from the fresh guide to direct self-contained apphost commands, including --help and the exact guide, compile, run, resume, status, and inspection operations used.

outputs.package_index_link: Absolute URL to the package index page that matches the bound runtime version and channel.
outputs.package_index_links: Released/beta package index absolute URL set, including localized mirrors when they exist.
outputs.guide_hub: Authoritative SO guide hub source at docs/en/guides/so-guide.md; the extracted runtime guide_path is guides/so-guide.md, limited to 200 lines.
outputs.guide_flow: SO governed operational flow source at docs/en/guides/so-guide-flow.md and extracted runtime page at guides/so-guide-flow.md.
outputs.guide_reference: SO concise reference index source at docs/en/guides/so-guide-reference.md; chapter pages use docs/en/guides/so-guide-reference-<chapter>.md and are packaged with the English docs bundle.
outputs.package_lock_template_example: Path to the standard SO package lock template example that skills being enhanced should follow.
outputs.package_lock_file: Machine-readable SO package lock with product identity, detected RID, channel, and exact resolved version.
outputs.checked_in_package_lock_asset: Checked-in SO package lock asset path that remains the authoritative source deliverable for the enhancement slice.
outputs.reenhancement_channel_confirmation: When re-enhancing a target already enhanced by Loom Skill Orchestrator, record the derived released-or-beta channel evidence from the bound runtime version and package lock without a user prompt.
outputs.guide_refresh_evidence: Evidence that the exact published Loom Skill Orchestrator self-contained RID apphost started directly and its first runtime operation, --guide, succeeded. Verify the exact version, absolute docs_root and guide_path, containment, and readability. Package identity/hash/manifest/archive failures, unsafe extraction, apphost startup or guide-command failures, and unreadable or out-of-root guide paths keep this evidence failed. MCP registration is optional after guide capture and cannot gate this evidence.
outputs.runtime_semantic_probe_evidence: Runtime-owned exact-version evidence for inherited/replacement fixtures, emitter results, canonical resume projection, and gov4 branch/cycle ordering, including expected versus observed values and audit/event paths.
outputs.batch_migration_evidence: Runtime-owned migration evidence containing idempotent script paths, dry-scan manifest, changed/unchanged/failed target lists, and per-target post-migration validation. Script hashes may be recorded but are optional development-support metadata.
outputs.decision_evidence_manifest: Runtime-owned evidence index for assumptions, decisions, superseded decisions, probe records, events.jsonl, and audit artifacts under <execution-output-root>/evidence/.
outputs.resolved_runtime_version: Exact published self-contained SO package version used by the enhancement pass.
outputs.runtime_cache_evidence: Machine-readable exact-cache result with cache hit, downloaded package, identity/hash/manifest validation, source, RID, and package paths.
outputs.runtime_bundle_packages: The single exact-RID self-contained SO runtime package ID, version, hash, manifest, and cache-validation evidence.
outputs.unified_runtime_directory: External per-run directory containing the safely extracted self-contained apphost and English docs.
outputs.target_skill_lock_reference: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced references assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json as the exact SO package version authority and describes validation of one exact product+RID package.
outputs.checked_in_skill_markdown_asset: Checked-in SKILL.md path for the skill being enhanced that remains the authoritative source deliverable for the enhancement slice.
outputs.target_skill_json_edit_policy: Explicit checked-in SKILL.md rule that ordinary workflow changes use the direct SO apphost and direct JSON edits are blocked-state-only, user-approved emergency workarounds.
outputs.target_skill_selective_json_reading_poli: Evidence that the checked-in target SKILL.md contains the selective JSON reading recommendation and corresponding structured exact line/quote review record.
outputs.target_skill_runtime_copy_policy: Explicit checked-in SKILL.md rule that every new official SO run starts from a freshly copied external runtime workflow file rather than the checked-in template itself, while resume continues against the same persisted runtime copy from that execution chain.
outputs.target_skill_guide_hub_structure: Evidence that an skill being enhanced publishes a guide hub at or below 200 lines and links adjacent flow and reference pages without changing the guide_path contract.
outputs.target_skill_workflow_file_language: Explicit checked-in rule for the SKILL.md of the skill being enhanced that workflow definition files for the skill being enhanced use English as the canonical information carrier for workflow-owned schema and control metadata, while user/business payload values and localized presentation remain source/request-language data.
outputs.target_skill_progress_report_policy: Evidence that the checked-in target SKILL.md requires complete per-execution Markdown entries at <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md, prepared as a separate entry file and written by the Windows AppendProgressReport.ps1 or Linux/macOS AppendProgressReport.sh helper. It requires UTC and local timestamps with numeric offset and OS timezone ID, states that the helper reads only the entry file and append-writes the target, requires reuse of the helper's full file URL when reporting the log address, forbids reading or inspecting existing target content, and requires failure reporting plus a pause without runtime-state mutation.
outputs.target_skill_runtime_hardening: The SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced requires exact package integrity and manifest checks, safe ZIP extraction, direct apphost guide validation, and fail-fast failure evidence. Only self-contained RID packages are supported.
outputs.requested_target_skill_changes: Requested skill being enhanced files/contracts/assets that must be created or modified in this enhancement pass.
outputs.target_skill_contract: Checked-in target-owned contract at <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/contract.json. It is the current business contract input for planning and workflow authoring, not a copy of the enhancement skill contract.
outputs.target_skill_contract_evidence: Machine-readable evidence for the target-owned contract: normalized target-relative path, parse result, target identity, required-surface checks, current_contract reference entry, and alignment against SKILL.md, workflow template, node map, gates, inputs, outputs, and requested changes. source SHA-256 is optional support metadata; read and validate the actual current file.
outputs.workflow_validation_contract: For workflows for the skill being enhanced that use root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, preserve that root templateKind and add validation.gates, validation.routes, validation.declaredUserOwnedFields, and validation.reservedRuntimeOwnedFields.
outputs.route_output_gate_evidence: Route-aware evidence that done paths satisfy declared business-output gates and blocked paths satisfy declared strongest-earned blocked-output gates when a workflow or runtime already emits that family. A completion manifest may reference this family when it already exists, but it must not fabricate a new route-proof surface inside the same terminal step just to satisfy its own verdict.
outputs.boundary_check_trail: Per-transition boundary-check and approval-gate trail for every governed transition on the same external runtime workflow copy: which gate predicates were checked, seam ownership verified, route coverage confirmed, and the explicit user approval or structured non-human continuation payload (literal skill_hint plus blocked step kind) that allowed each next step. An unapproved or fail-closed transition must appear as failed state in this trail.
outputs.fresh_external_workflow_instance: Fresh external runtime workflow instance copy used by the official SO run/resume chain; never the checked-in source template.
outputs.workflow_file: Single external runtime workflow file path used for compile, run, and every resume in the same official execution chain; it must not be replaced by an independent compile-only input.
outputs.workflow_file_language: Evidence that the workflow definition uses English for workflow-owned schema and control metadata while preserving source-language user/business payload values and localized presentation output.
outputs.workflow_instance_identity: Immutable identity linking the external workflow instance, its workflow-file path, and the official run/resume chain.
outputs.workflow_identity: Evidence that taskType and workflowKind match the declared business scope, caseId identifies the business case, and one runId is preserved across compile, run, resume, audit, and completion evidence.
outputs.persisted_runtime_state: Persisted SO runtime state/session path that every resume call must reuse for the same workflow instance.
outputs.workflow_template: Deterministic workflow JSON template path. The template becomes execution authority after guide alignment, governance review, and successful direct-apphost compile.
outputs.workflow_analysis_report: workflow.analysis.json path containing generated analysis of inputs, outputs, branches, loops, seams, gates, and Turing-complete control risk.
outputs.workflow_compile_feedback: workflow.compile-feedback.json path containing the shared workflow.compile-feedback.v1 result, including status, counts, stable diagnostics, phase barriers, candidate path, and runtime identity/version. Candidate hashes are optional development-support metadata. Failed candidates retain feedback and backups without successful Mermaid or HTML placeholders.
outputs.output_path_addressability: Every output path is a normalized real filesystem path and must be verified as existing and readable even when it is outside the Git worktree or ignored. When workspace mirroring is available, retain the verified workspace-relative path for direct editor opening.
outputs.workflow_dataflow_report: workflow.dataflow.json path containing transition-level payload, projection, producer, family, gate, and route evidence.
outputs.plan_output_path: Runtime-owned per-run path to plan/skill-plan.md under the execution output root; this is a reference, not a skill being enhanced asset path.
outputs.plan_hash: Optional content hash of the runtime-owned per-run plan/skill-plan.md artifact; it is support metadata, not a development freshness gate.
outputs.workflow_designer_dispatch_record: Record that the required local workflow-designer subagent was dispatched for template generation or revision, including the relative-link context set used for that dispatch.
outputs.expression_contract_fragment: The exact expressionBinding contract fragment delivered to the workflow designer and preserved in the generated workflow root.
outputs.gate_failure_guidance_review: Machine-readable self-review record from the workflow designer enumerating every gate and proving that its failureGuidance nextAction and path/line/quote evidenceReferences were checked before template delivery.
outputs.weave_out_subagent_review: Review summary that decides whether each current weave-out should become a dedicated local subagent for the skill being enhanced and records the required subagent-definition follow-up.
outputs.target_skill_subagent_assets: Local subagent definition files for the skill being enhanced, created or refreshed under assets/ as a result of the weave-out suitability review.
outputs.target_skill_subagent_link_updates: Relative-link updates applied to the SKILL.md for the skill being enhanced and reference docs for the skill being enhanced for any local weave-out subagent files for the skill being enhanced introduced by this enhancement pass.
outputs.localized_review_plan: User-readable workflow and implementation review plan in the requested language when that language is not English.
outputs.compiled_mermaid: Compiled Mermaid Markdown path generated from the workflow template, including node-type coloring derived from step kind semantics.
outputs.confirmation_loop_transcript: Record of user feedback rounds and the workflow-template changes made in response before execution approval.
outputs.review_fix_loop_evidence: Evidence from the explicit review-skill to fix-skill loop run before completion, including the final reviewed delta and the resulting skill being enhanced corrections.
outputs.node_to_file_map: Machine-readable or Markdown evidence map from workflow node ids to target-root-relative checked-in files, target-internal SO/AO reference copies, generated artifacts, or audit records. The map must not use absolute paths, .. traversal, repository-global docs/ paths, or another skill root for checked-in document references.
outputs.target_internal_document_root: Target-local reference roots at assets/so-workflow/reference/so/ and assets/so-workflow/reference/ao/ for complete SO/AO guide pages extracted from the exact bound runtime package; the fresh published-runtime guide_path remains authoritative, while these package-derived pages are duplicated locally for deterministic skill being enhanced inspection.
outputs.internal_document_evidence: Evidence that every mapped document exists inside the skill being enhanced root, missing SO/AO excerpts were copied safely, and the document-copy manifest records source path/product/channel/version, artifact origin, authority scope, and refresh provenance. Support context/source hashes are optional in development; package SHA-512 integrity remains mandatory whenever a package is used.
outputs.audit_artifacts: Mermaid Markdown, HTML, workflow JSON backup, workflow analysis, and workflow dataflow paths. The fixed user-facing report contains exactly four verified items in Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow order, preserving established labels and surrounding format. Each title is a native Markdown file link when supported, never raw HTML <a>, targeting its complete absolute verified runtime address normalized with /. For paths containing spaces, use angle brackets and preserve literal spaces; do not quote or encode spaces as %20. Immediately follow each link with a text fence containing only the identical complete absolute path, with literal spaces and no quotes or encoding. Verified workspace-relative mirrors are only for separate host/editor open actions. For not_emitted, repeat only a previously verified report and state the render is unchanged; if none exists, report missing evidence without links. runtime_path_only uses absolute report addresses; delivery_failed produces no link or notification.
outputs.mermaid_delivery: Machine-readable Mermaid delivery evidence emitted by the runtime for generated, reused, or failed artifacts, with status, generation_status, artifact_generated, link_resolvable, workspace-relative Mermaid/HTML paths, visual_preview_rendered, card_display_available, SHA-256 values, and failure details. When a current call returns no mermaid_delivery object, the host may derive host-only not_emitted for presentation continuity; that host state is not runtime evidence.
outputs.mermaid_artifact_delivery_reference: Target-local delivery contract at reference/mermaid-artifact-delivery.md; it defines actual-path validation, workspace mirroring, link states, HTML preview, card handling, and fail-closed reporting.
outputs.audit_reuse_evidence: Runtime-owned audit-reuse.json provenance containing source and destination step directories, source workflow/instance identity when available, source artifact SHA-256 values, verified-by/reason fields, artifact_origin=verified-copy, and official_execution_evidence=false.
outputs.audit_reuse_policy: Only an explicit copy-audit-step request or a run/resume invocation carrying --reuse-audit-step, --reuse-audit-reason, and --reuse-audit-verified-by may reuse a verified unchanged audit step. Copied render artifacts never create runtime transition, event-log, gate, guide, or completion evidence and must not replace run/resume execution.
outputs.completion_manifest_reference: Runtime-owned completion-manifest path that references checked-in source deliverables without overwriting them and anchors the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist surface for final completion handoff.
outputs.completion_manifest_md: Runtime-owned completion-manifest file path used as the human-reviewable terminal artifact for the completion_manifest_md output family. It must include a fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist section that summarizes the current status and node, whether final Done was reached, any missing evidence, the next action, and explicit mappings back to existing runtime-owned evidence families instead of a parallel completion schema. That summary may explain the verdict rule, but it must not invent a new terminal-only route-proof surface that replaces pre-existing runtime evidence.
outputs.commit_report_ready: Completion-time report evidence that the skill being enhanced is ready for commit and reporting handoff after the required review-fix loop.
outputs.published_package_workflow_evidence: Evidence that workflow operations used the published exact-version self-contained SO product+RID package rather than repository source builds or hand-assembled runtimes.
outputs.runtime_preflight_result: Package identity, exact version, RID, SHA-512, nuspec, runtime manifest, archive safety, extraction, and apphost readiness result before guide dispatch.
outputs.completion_by_target_skill_changes: Completion requires the requested deliverables of the skill being enhanced to be created or modified. Runtime-only validation artifacts are insufficient completion evidence.
outputs.think_out_loud_runtime_summary: Report exact package version, package identity/hash/RID, extraction directory, and direct apphost path after preparation and after each SO runtime call.
outputs.think_out_loud_audit_paths: Think-out-loud reports mermaid_file, html_file, analysis_file, dataflow_file, execution_confidence, and estimated_overall_progress after every SO binary execution. Begin with exactly four verified report items in Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow order, preserving established labels and format. Each title is a native Markdown file link when supported, never raw HTML <a>, targeting the complete absolute runtime file address normalized with /. For paths with spaces, use angle brackets and preserve literal spaces; do not quote or encode as %20. Immediately follow each link with a text fence containing only the identical complete absolute path, with literal spaces and no quotes or encoding. Then print localized confidence and progress headings. Use verified paths only; delivery_failed has no artifact links.
outputs.session_mermaid_continuity: After every SO binary execution, report exactly four verified Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, and Dataflow items in that order, preserving the existing labels and report format. Each title is a native Markdown file link when supported, never raw HTML <a>, using its complete absolute verified runtime address normalized with /. For paths containing spaces, wrap the target in angle brackets and preserve literal spaces; do not quote or encode spaces as %20. Immediately follow each link with a text fence containing only the identical complete absolute path, with literal spaces, no quotes, and no percent encoding. Then give the workflow-location summary and localized confidence/progress headings. For not_emitted, repeat only a previously verified unchanged report; if none exists or delivery_failed occurs, report missing evidence and next action without links.
outputs.must_show_to_user_files: Ordered audit path list for the current SO execution; not a link guarantee. The fixed report contains exactly four verified Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, and Dataflow items in order, preserving labels and surrounding format. Each title uses a native Markdown file link when supported, never raw HTML <a>, to the complete absolute runtime address. If a target contains spaces, use angle brackets and literal spaces, with no quotes or %20 encoding. Immediately follow each title with a text fence containing only the identical complete absolute path with literal spaces. Workspace-relative mirrors are separate host/editor actions only. Apply continuity and delivery-failure handling without guessing.
outputs.plain_language_feedback: Evidence that user-facing SO, AO-facing handoff, and skill being enhanced updates use the user's requested language and high-school-readable everyday language first, with technical commands, paths, IDs, and evidence fields separated as optional details.
outputs.workflow_location_summary: Concise user-facing summary of where the active SO workflow currently is after the current CLI call: current stage, frontier/block/completed status, and whether the Mermaid render changed. Governance verdict and evidence checklist reporting may reference that summary when the runtime already emitted it, but workflow templates should not assume it exists in workflow context unless they explicitly persisted it earlier.
outputs.latest_guide_review: When performed, a subagent review summary comparing the current skill being enhanced and workflow assets against the guide result captured from the current skill-bound runtime.
outputs.reenhancement_template_strategy_review: Runtime-owned strategy judgment comparing the old template, current requirements and concept documents, assets of the skill being enhanced, gap reviews, and the fresh guide.
outputs.reenhancement_template_change_strategy: Selected re-enhancement template strategy: local_patch, structural_refactor, or full_regeneration.
outputs.reenhancement_template_change_evidence: Supporting conflict, impact, baseline-input, and old-to-new mapping evidence for the selected re-enhancement template strategy.
outputs.shared_review_context: Bounded shared review context containing the source manifest, bounded snapshots, selected guide/schema/runtime references, and the external workflow-copy identity. context_hash is optional development-support metadata and never a re-attestation or freshness gate.
outputs.parallel_review_batch_evidence: Evidence that every independent re-enhancement or planning review in the declared external whenAllPass batch returned against the shared context before aggregation.
outputs.aggregated_reenhancement_findings: One complete aggregate of all re-enhancement gap findings, preserving each finding and its accepted/rebutted/needs_validation disposition.
outputs.aggregated_plan_findings: One complete aggregate of all independent scope, route/gate, and evidence/node-map planning findings.
outputs.aggregated_review_findings: One complete pre-repair aggregate containing every independent review finding and disposition.
outputs.batch_repair_evidence: Evidence that one coordinated repair consumed the complete aggregate and updated all affected skill being enhanced and workflow deliverables together.
outputs.parallel_post_fix_validation_evidence: Evidence that every independent post-fix validator returned against the repaired deliverables before serial validation.
outputs.aggregated_post_fix_validation: One complete aggregate of all post-fix validation results, unresolved blockers, and preserved strengths.
outputs.serial_validation_evidence: Final ordered validation evidence covering structured JSON, graph/dataflow, compile, and runtime checks after all parallel validation results arrived.
outputs.template_governance_evidence: Evidence that the workflow template uses explicit governed steps, guards, seams, reviewable outputs, route-aware business-output gates, and ownership-safe seams, with no node intent that says or implies run a multistep plan.
outputs.reference_manifest: Object descriptor for runtime-owned reference-manifest.json. Require path, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.reference-manifest.v1, verdict, runtimeVersion, and generationSetId. sha256 is optional development-support metadata and not a freshness or re-attestation gate.
outputs.reference_authority_decision: Machine-readable authority decision recording exact-runtime precedence, current-contract precedence, previous_runnable_reference disposition, and any rejected source claims.
outputs.layered_static_validation: Ordered runtime, JSON, graph, enum, expression, projection, dataflow, gate, ownership, and semantic preflight result. It must stop at the first failed or required-unknown layer.
outputs.expression_audit: Structured audit of every guard, success, and gate expression, including complete ExpressionDefinition shape, source location, boolean result type where required, detailedCompileFeedbackV1, and the corresponding ExpressionCompileFeedback reference.
outputs.projection_matrix: Per-external-transition projection matrix covering requiredInputs, resumeOutputKey, outputPath, explicit outputBindings, value types, and ownership.
outputs.gate_producer_route_matrix: Matrix proving each required output family has one reachable concrete producer through transition outputPath or explicit outputBindings, value semantics, consuming gate, route coverage, current-instance binding, and failure action; condition branches and publish declarations alone are not producers.
outputs.previous_runnable_reference_disposition: Disposition for each previous runnable workflow, including source version/path/copy time, reusable shapes, current schema/requirements differences, and rejected/deprecated items. source_hash is optional development-support metadata and never a freshness gate.
outputs.static_contract_review: Object descriptor for runtime-owned static-contract-review.json. Require path, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.static-contract-review.v1, verdict, runtimeVersion, and the full ordered layer/expression/projection/producer/gate/ownership audit. sha256 is optional development-support metadata and not a freshness gate. Require `contextFieldTypeComparisons` for every added or changed `context_fields` path: declared JSON/container type, independent actual producer output or authoritative producer schema, observed type, runtime/version, source path, and verdict. The edited contract or a runtime echo is not independent evidence; missing, unknown, or mismatched comparisons block a passing verdict.
outputs.semantic_probe_report: Object descriptor for runtime-owned semantic-probe-report.json. Require path, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.semantic-probe-report.v1, runtimeVersion, stable probe ids, and expected/observed evidence. The verdict passes only when every required probe passes; sha256 is optional support metadata.
outputs.workflow_design_evidence: Descriptor set returned by the designer for the three runtime-owned workflow-design JSON records. Require normalized paths, fixed schemaVersion values, verdicts, selected runtime version/provenance, and generationSetId as grouping metadata. Development-support SHA-256 values are optional and do not attest freshness.
outputs.phase_design_evidence: Typed summary of mode, authored_state_node_count, per-phase results, aggregated interface changes, impact decision, merged-candidate full-compile result, repair counts, and verdict. record_key must be phaseDesignEvidence and record_path must equal static_contract_review.path; detailed phaseDesignEvidence stays in the existing static-contract-review.json, with no fourth report.
outputs.governed_producer_matrix: Per-transition emitter and output-family matrix distinguishing declarations, concrete producer paths, prior context guarantees, known-null emitters, unknown emitters, and self-binding failures.
outputs.migration_manifest: Idempotent migration manifest containing script paths, dry-scan results, changed/unchanged/failed targets, ambiguity findings, validation results, and rollback point. Script and intermediate source/candidate hashes are optional development-support metadata.
outputs.apphost_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping from the skill runtime flow to the public direct apphost commands, based on the fresh guide and --help output.
